lines.text: The fifth angel sounds his trumpet, and a fallen star opens the pit of the Abyss, and smoke darkens the sun.
Locusts with scorpion-like power come out of the smoke and may only torment people without God's seal for three months.
The locusts look like horses prepared for battle, and their king is the angel of the Abyss.
A voice from the golden altar tells the sixth angel to release four angels bound at the river Jordan.
The rest of mankind did not repent of their works and kept worshiping demons and idols.
